tasks.title: Photo identification
tasks.primaryMetric: Evidence-supported outcome per scheduled observation; separate named precision, yield and supported rank.
tasks.coverage: Species, genus/family, unresolved biology, nonbiology, lookalikes and cultivated subjects; subject/near-duplicate clusters kept together.
tasks.qualificationRequirements: Frozen paired held-out comparison; practical effect and uncertainty, category guardrails, mapping and technical failures; task-specific latency/cost ceilings.
tasks.nextAction: Retain released photo configuration. Advance only a candidate that passes development, then audit unexposed eligibility and freeze a new validation protocol.

tasks.title: Recognizing insufficient visual evidence
tasks.primaryMetric: Supported rank or appropriate biological abstention per scheduled observation; retain species answers when supported.
tasks.coverage: Sharp but nondiagnostic images, missing views, occlusion, small subjects, genus/family references, biological and nonbiological controls.
tasks.qualificationRequirements: Feature claims independently assessed against exact pixels; no hindsight relabeling; false abstention and unsupported specificity measured separately.
tasks.nextAction: Use the prepared 18-case exposed screen as development only; it has no model results. Follow its frozen hurdle before any new validation.

tasks.title: Calibrated confidence for photo answers
tasks.primaryMetric: Precision and coverage at prospectively selected thresholds, with uncertainty; calibration error only as a supplementary measure.
tasks.coverage: Final selected configuration, every supported rank and subject state, high-score errors, abstentions, mapping gaps and technical failures.
tasks.qualificationRequirements: Separate calibration and untouched validation sets; select thresholds on calibration only; freeze target precision, minimum coverage and interval rule.
tasks.nextAction: Select a worthwhile identification configuration first. Existing fallback thresholds carry no new calibration guarantee.

tasks.title: Photo explanation grounding
tasks.primaryMetric: Fraction of scheduled explanations with supported visual claims, consistent uncertainty and useful alternatives; unassessable references separate.
tasks.coverage: Lookalikes, unsupported specificity, missing views, correct and incorrect identifications, insufficient-reference controls.
tasks.qualificationRequirements: Blinded independent review with anchored rubric, agreement reporting and predeclared dispute policy; correctness alone does not qualify explanations.
tasks.nextAction: Strengthen diagnostic references and review coverage; reuse the private review machinery, preserving limits of assistant-led review.

tasks.title: Audio identification
tasks.primaryMetric: Evidence-supported audible caller identification or appropriate unresolved/nonbiological outcome per scheduled clip.
tasks.coverage: Verified synchronized callers, near-confusable calls, multiple/background sources, silence, machinery and environmental sounds; source-recording clusters.
tasks.qualificationRequirements: Audible reference adjudication before calls; fixed DSP/context and paired unseen clips; source label alone is insufficient.
tasks.nextAction: Resolve disputed audible references before another quality comparison; preserve the demonstrated DSP and confidence-semantic fixes as separate engineering evidence.

tasks.title: Identification from descriptions
tasks.primaryMetric: Most specific identification supported by the supplied text per scheduled description.
tasks.coverage: Species/genus-only descriptions, ambiguous traits, insufficient context and nonbiological controls; paraphrase clusters.
tasks.qualificationRequirements: References limited to information in the model-visible text; no hidden image/source-label inference; paired unseen descriptions.
tasks.nextAction: Build reviewed description-only references and audit exposure; current mixed pilots do not qualify this task.

tasks.title: Video identification
tasks.primaryMetric: Supported outcome per scheduled source observation through a frozen frame/audio preparation pipeline.
tasks.coverage: Changing views, subject selection, movement, poor frames and controls; all clips/frames of the same source stay in one split.
tasks.qualificationRequirements: Evaluate the full declared pipeline; photo performance cannot qualify video or isolate model effect from preprocessing.
tasks.nextAction: Define approved representative video assets and source-cluster/reference rules before comparing models.
